notes.title: Banana Cat Update!
notes.content:
Hello, Banana Cat Community! 🐱🍌

We haven’t disappeared—[b]we’ve been busy adding two exciting new bananas for you to discover![/b] 🌟

Here’s what’s new:

[b]Stonkscatnana[/b]
[url=https://i.imgur.com/andw0R4.png][img]https://i.imgur.com/andw0R4.png[/img][/url]

[b]Brazilian Samurai Cat[/b]
[url=https://i.imgur.com/IpU6Qwg.png][img]https://i.imgur.com/IpU6Qwg.png[/img][/url]

Get ready to find them and let us know which one is your favorite! 🎉

notes.title: Crafting Update!
notes.content:
[b]Hey guys![/b] We are back with a new[b] huge update[/b]! We are continuously learning from your reviews (thanks) and we have fixed issues and made a [b]CRAFTING[/b] mechanic.
[b]How do you access to the crafting menu?[/b]
If you click the forging icon in the game (image of a cat forging a banana) some icons will pop up with a cat+cat2=cat3 type of thing, for now you can craft only one cat ([b]sleepyworkercatnana[/b]) and we think that we will change the craftings every 2 weeks (this might change though).

Video of the update:
[previewyoutube=2I5Se575wj8;full][/previewyoutube]

Fixes: 
azerty keyboard’s konami code now working

Remember to join our [b]Discord[/b] server if you need help, send us your catnanas or just want to chat! 
https://discord.gg/BxXUknk6qe

notes.title: Flappy Update! (new mode)
notes.content:
We have added a new mode for all the people that think banana cat is not a real game!
The mode is called "[b]Flappy Nana[/b]" and we'll leave a YouTube video link so that you can see what it is about.
Video of the update: [previewyoutube=uRW_oKI8wmk;full][/previewyoutube]

Fixes:
-165/144/120hz monitor high GPU usage 
-Now the game saves the amount of clicks when you close it

notes.title: Banana Cat Has Been Released!
notes.content:
Guys [b]Banana Cat[/b] has [b]been released![/b] In the first week of its release the "[b]GnomeCatnana[/b]" (Common rarity) will be available for only 7 days (until the 15th of july - 8 am)! Try to obtain it as soon as possible so that when it would be unobtainable it will value a lot! What are you waiting for?
[url=https://i.imgur.com/Gtd9bf7.png][img]https://i.imgur.com/Gtd9bf7.png[/img][/url]
Rarities (they drop every hour) : 
[list]
[*] Common - 58,89%
[*] Rare - 15%
[*] Epic - 5%
[*] Mystical -  1% 
[*] Legendary - 0,1%
[*]  The Real Cat Deal - 0,01%
[/list]
